title: Prescription drugs; mail order opt out option.
bodyText: A Hawaii employer-union health benefits trust fund health benefits plan shall permit each beneficiary to fill any covered prescription in accordance with chapter 431R.
bodyHtml: [§87A-16.3]  Prescription drugs; mail order opt out option.  A Hawaii employer-union health benefits trust fund health benefits plan shall permit each beneficiary to fill any covered prescription in accordance with chapter 431R. [L 2013, c 226, §3]
